name: Art History
notes: Five courses: two or three at the 100 level and two or three at the 200/300 level.
Individual programs can be designed in consultation with the art history advisor.
The 100-level courses should come from the group listed under the art history major requirements; the planner accepts any 100-level AHST course.

requirementGroups.label: Two 100-level art history courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A minor consist of five courses: Two or three 100-level courses from the group listed under art history major requirements

requirementGroups.label: Two 200- or 300-level art history courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Two or three 200 or 300-level program courses

requirementGroups.label: A fifth art history course at either level
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: A minor consist of five courses: Two or three 100-level courses ... Two or three 200 or 300-level program courses
requirementGroups.note: The split is two-or-three each way, so the fifth course may be at either level.
